parameters.jsCode: const body=$input.first().json.body;const required=['version','changes'];const missing=required.filter(f=>!body[f]);if(missing.length)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'Missing: '+missing.join(', ')}}];const changes=Array.isArray(body.changes)?body.changes:[];if(changes.length===0)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'changes must be a non-empty array'}}];const validTypes=['feature','improvement','bugfix','breaking_change','deprecation','performance','security'];const formattedChanges=changes.slice(0,50).map((c,i)=>({id:'C'+String(i+1).padStart(3,'0'),type:validTypes.includes(c.type)?c.type:'improvement',title:(c.title||'').trim().slice(0,150),description:(c.description||'').trim().slice(0,500),jiraTicket:c.jira_ticket||c.ticket||'',audience:c.audience||'all',internal:c.internal===true||c.internal==='true'})).filter(c=>c.title);if(formattedChanges.length===0)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'No valid changes with titles found'}}];const audiences=['all','developers','admins','end_users'];const outputFormats=['all','user_facing','technical','changelog_md'];const outputFormat=outputFormats.includes(body.output_format)?body.output_format:'all';return[{json:{valid:true,version:body.version.trim(),releaseDate:body.release_date||new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],productName:(body.product_name||'').trim(),changes:formattedChanges,outputFormat,tone:body.tone||'clear_and_friendly',includeInternalNotes:body.include_internal_notes===true||body.include_internal_notes==='true',replyEmail:body.reply_email||null}}];

values.content: You write software release notes in three styles: (1) user-facing — benefit-led, non-technical, explains what users can now do; (2) technical — precise, includes what changed and how, useful for developers; (3) a combined changelog format. Good release notes translate engineering changes into user outcomes. 'Fixed a null pointer exception in the authentication module' becomes 'Fixed a bug that caused some users to be logged out unexpectedly'. Always respond in valid JSON only.
